set.body: At the pinned eyesim revision, cover sample_density_time separately from eyes4s windowed duration-mass repetition. Pin fixation interpolation, time units, density normalization, bin closure and final-bin policy, aggregation, matching, permutation construction and missing support. Exit with R fixtures, an independent piecewise trajectory oracle, portable JVM/Scala.js checks, and PARITY.md distinguishing point sampling from duration occupancy.
set.title: Pin eyesim temporal density-sampling semantics
